Precise location saves your track, separates movement and stops, and recognizes routes. Notifications show recording status and a stop action. Recording starts only when you choose; a location foreground service continues with the screen off. No all-day background location is requested. Operate only while parked.
Precise location was not granted. Allow it in system settings; saved rides can still be browsed.
Notifications are denied. Recording can continue; return to the app to finish, or use the system task manager.
No rides yet. Record your first ride, then turn it into a commute route.
Familiar routes begin with one ride. Open a completed ride in Journal to create a route.
No valid commutes this month. Link rides to routes. Excluded, interrupted, or incomplete rides are omitted.

Confirm endpoint areas. The route uses this ride’s selected boundaries; inspect the trace first.
Endpoints use the first and last valid selected fixes. The hollow marker is the start; the filled marker is the end.
A route needs at least 4 valid fixes and 150 m of track.
